gizmo.title: Rohe tuku atahanga
gizmo.description: Ka whakanoho ngā ākonga i ngā tapanga ki ngā rohe kei runga i tētahi atahanga, kātahi ka arowhai i tā rātou whakautu.

configure.title: Atahanga
configure.description: Te atahanga e whakanohoia ai e ngā ākonga ngā tapanga.

configure.title: Kuputuhi kē
configure.description: Ka whakaahua i te atahanga mō te hunga kāore e kite. Kaua e whāki i te wāhi e haere ai ngā tapanga.

configure.title: Taitara atahanga
configure.description: He taitara poto e kitea ana mō te atahanga, ka whakaaturia i runga ake.

configure.title: Pātai
configure.description: Te mea e tonoa ana ngā ākonga kia mahia ki ngā tapanga.

configure.title: Ngā tapanga me ngā rohe
configure.description: He tapanga ia tūemi ka taea e ngā ākonga te whakanoho. Hoatu he ingoa rohe ki tētahi tapanga kia puta tōna rohe i te atahanga; ko te tapanga kāore he ingoa rohe he tāpiri kāore e tika ki hea. Ko ngā tau rohe he ōrau o te atahanga.

configure.title: Tapanga
configure.description: He tapanga kōwhiri ka whakaaturia i raro i te atahanga.

advanced.title: Ngā ngana
advanced.description: E hia ngā wā ka taea e te ākonga te arowhai. Ko te 0 te tikanga kāore he tepe.

advanced.title: Kōrapu ngā tapanga
advanced.description: Whakaaturia ngā tapanga ki tētahi raupapa rerekē i ia toronga.

advanced.title: Ka taea te kōpaki
advanced.description: Whakaaturia tēnei pātai hei rārangi ka tuwhera, ka kati hoki. Ka kati te whakatuwhera i tētahi i ētahi atu pātai kōpaki i tōna taha.

advanced.title: Tīmata kua kōpakina
advanced.description: Ina taea te kōpaki, tīmata hei rārangi kua kati e whakaatu ana i te pātai me tōna tūnga anake.

advanced.title: Hōputu kōeke
advanced.description: OER Schema: hōputu kōeke mō tēnei aromatawai (hei tauira, ngā piro, te reta, te ōrau, te whakaoti).

advanced.title: Whāinga ako
advanced.description: OER Schema: te whāinga ako e hāngai ana ki tēnei aromatawai.

developer.title: Ingoa o te pātaitai
developer.description: Te ingoa pātaitai e whakamahia ana mō te tautohu xAPI i ngā pūnaha tātari.

developer.title: Akoranga
developer.description: OER Schema: te akoranga e whakaritea ana tēnei aromatawai.
